tonight.headline: Zvada's 2 is still the hole — Montgomery out makes Marks a coin flip
body: Bad news first: Dominic Zvada, added Thursday for Matt Gay, kicked 2.0 against Washington (archive); Gay plays Sunday at Las Vegas and anything above 2.0 makes that swap a loss. New since this morning: Houston ruled David Montgomery out Saturday (NBC 14 Nov 18:38Z), so Woody Marks is the lead back again and ESPN lifted him to 14.2 — 1.5 behind Ollie Gordon at FLEX. That is a coin flip; the projection keeps Gordon, and that is how the lineup is set.

Daniels 20.3, Likely 27.7 and Zvada 2.0 are banked: 49.96 to 0 against the 9-0 Maye-day. ESPN: 140.3 to 126.8, 58%. No projected starter is in doubt, so there is no Sunday check. Nothing to do before kickoff.

case.label: Their side
case.body: Maye-day start Alvin Kamara (8.1) — and the Saints activated Travis Etienne off IR Saturday into a split with Kamara and Estime (ESPN 14 Nov). KC Concepcion (10.6) gains if Denzel Boston, a game-day decision, sits. Jaxon Smith-Njigba (22.4) and Brock Bowers (15.5) carry their projection.

case.label: Why Gordon, not Marks
case.body: Montgomery's ruling came Saturday and ESPN has already moved Marks from 9.0 to 14.2 — the news is priced. 15.7 against 14.2 is inside the two-point line, where even ESPN is right 56% of the time. Take the projection and write no thesis.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: A surprise inactive among Taylor, Tuten, Gordon, Golden or Rice — none has a designation (NFL.com Week 10). Then Marks (14.2) or Pickens (12.3) fills in.

whatWentWrong.title: The kicker stream cost points before Sunday began
whatWentWrong.lead: Zvada for Gay on a 10.7-to-8.3 projection; the projection then fell to 8.1, and Zvada kicked 2.0.

case.label: What happened
case.body: The brief recommended Zvada as a free agent Wednesday; the add was made Thursday 13:16Z. By 22:05Z ESPN had cut him to 8.1 against Gay's 8.3 with no reporting found to explain it. Thursday: 2.0 (archive).

case.label: The rule it bent
case.body: STRATEGY §5: a stream needs a real gap, not a marginal one. 2.4 projected points on a kicker was marginal, and the slot changed for it.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Gay scores 2.0 or less Sunday — then the swap ties or wins and closes RIGHT. Anything more closes it WRONG on the outcome. Either way: no kicker stream under a 3-point gap for the rest of the season.
